svg.title: Adding a document to Knowledge
svg.desc: 1. A user uploads a file; text is extracted on the server. 2. An admin approves or rejects it; employees' uploads stay pending until then. 3. Approved text is chunked and embedded into pgvector. 4. Admins can re-index a document after changes.
